coordinate_constraint_anchor: One appended virtual root, all jumps fixed; removed before scoring
persistent_constraints: Explicit weight:coordinate_constraint 1.0 before each ramp stage; ramp_down_constraints(False); no script command lowers constraints

primary_InterfaceAnalyzer.score_function: fresh ref2015 with all restraint score terms zero

primary_replicate_reduction: Median interface_dG (REU), requiring all three complete, valid replicates; no best-seed selection or imputation
close_contact_definition: Antigen/binder physical heavy-atom pairs with distance strictly below 2 angstrom; not a van der Waals clash metric
rmsd_definition: Least-squares Kabsch-aligned matching N,CA,C,O coordinates, reflections excluded; complex and separate partners reported
input_chemistry_policy: Original strict adapter; allows OXT additions and qualified PRO virtual atoms plus hydrogens from PDB loader; rejects missing physical heavy atoms, altered original coordinates or residue mapping
relax_script:
repeat 5
weight:coordinate_constraint 1.0
scale:fa_rep 0.040
repack
scale:fa_rep 0.051
min 0.01
weight:coordinate_constraint 1.0
scale:fa_rep 0.265
repack
scale:fa_rep 0.280
min 0.01
weight:coordinate_constraint 1.0
scale:fa_rep 0.559
repack
scale:fa_rep 0.581
min 0.01
weight:coordinate_constraint 1.0
scale:fa_rep 1.0
repack
min 0.00001
accept_to_best
endrepeat

source_references.purpose: Documented FastRelax ramp and constraint semantics
Native automatic constraints add virtual root and set its jump movable, therefore manual anchor used
FastRelax script constructor and constraint-ramping behavior

source_audit_limit: Documentation/source reviewed on 2026-10-09; public main is not claimed identical to installed PyRosetta binary. Exact runtime version is pinned to each baseline case. Real runtime API validation and pilot remain required.
diagnostic_warning_policy: Prespecified warning only; inspect but do not remove cases, select seeds, impute, or change the three-valid-replicate median. Failed runs remain failures.
